weekly_ambitions.label: Bread for Every Hearth
weekly_ambitions.description: Produce or collect 12 loaves this week.

weekly_ambitions.label: Know Your Neighbors
weekly_ambitions.description: Gain 8 total friendship points this week.

weekly_ambitions.label: Secrets Beneath Stone
weekly_ambitions.description: Explore the ruins four times this week.

events.title: A Rhythm Takes Hold
events.speaker: Mabel
events.text: A village lives by more than walls. Watch the weekdays: work gathers toward the weekend market, and every season carries a promise.

events.title: The Henwife
events.speaker: Elin the Henwife
events.text: Elin arrives on the second Monday with a wicker basket and an alarming amount of clucking. Chicken coops and fresh eggs are now possible.

events.title: The Green Path
events.speaker: Brother Rowan
events.text: A traveling herbalist recognizes the valley's wild plants. He teaches the village to cultivate medicinal herbs instead of merely finding them.

events.title: The Northern Door
events.speaker: Edwin
events.text: After weeks of watching blue light pulse beneath the hill, Edwin finds the buried entrance. A new cache lies near the northern ruins.

events.title: Bees in the Clover
events.speaker: Ysabel
events.text: Summer flowers draw a beekeeper into the valley. Apiaries can turn herbs and patient labor into valuable honey.

events.title: The Great Summer Storm
events.speaker: Edwin
events.text: The river is rising. We can reinforce the granary, or open it now and feed every frightened family.

events.title: First Harvest Bell
events.speaker: Alys
events.text: Autumn begins. Wheat yields and market prices rise, but the village must preserve enough food for winter.

events.title: The Harvest Table
events.speaker: Mabel
events.text: The feast is two weeks away. Bread, eggs, honey, beauty and friendship will all be remembered when the tables are laid.

events.title: Harvest Feast
events.speaker: The Village
events.text: Work stops. Lanterns are lit and the whole valley gathers to judge the year not by its walls, but by what was shared.

events.title: First Snow
events.speaker: Hugh
events.text: Snow covers the valley. Outdoor work slows, hearth food matters more, and villagers spend longer together indoors.

events.title: The Astronomer
events.speaker: Lady Maud
events.text: An astronomer follows old eclipse tables to the valley. Her tower may reveal why the portal and the northern ruins answer the same stars.

events.title: The Long Eclipse
events.speaker: The Time Traveler
events.text: At noon the sun becomes a black coin. The portal wakes, the ruin answers, and for one impossible moment I remember building both.

events.title: A Year Remembered
events.speaker: Mabel
events.text: Four seasons ago this was only a valley. Tomorrow it begins again, carrying every kindness, ambition and mistake with it.

events.title: A Familiar Stranger
events.speaker: Unknown Traveler
events.text: A stranger arrives carrying a coin stamped with your face, dated one hundred years from now. Year Two has its own mysteries.
